item.title: Lizzie McGuire's dad has passed away
item.description: Hilary Duff's "heart aches" for her former Lizzie McGuire co-star Robert Carradine. item.title: Olivia Dean Spins Into Record Store Day Ambassador Role
item.description: Olivia Dean named Record Store Day 2026 ambassador 🎶 Olivia Dean is taking the vinyl spotlight as Record Store Day 2026 ambassador!
